svg.title: Components inside the procurement module
svg.desc: The procurement module is split into internal packages by work area and publishes only its api package. Finance calls procurement. Procurement calls platform and budget, and receives Finance facts through an SPI that finance implements. External links run through the outbox and adapters.

g.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif
